\\@MESSAGE@
Dantes is a character of many talents.\n
He is capable of playing at all ranges, and is threatening mid-range during neutral.\n
While his normals vary on advantage and range, he can always change his gameplan with his versatile kit.\n
\n
\k
\\@MESSAGE@
His \@C@ and \@2+C@ can oppress the air and ground respectively, with \@4+C@ being an attack that helps him back off.\n
Dancing outside of your opponent's range, Dantes has access to \@214+A@'s follow-ups, which can seem fast.\n
\n
Stay safe with follow-up \@A@, or trip them up low with follow-up \@B@.\n
Alternatively, forego this with a similar dashing \@B@.\n
\n
If you're far away, fill the screen with \@236+B@, increased \@236+B@, and \@236+C@.\n
And if you're feeling especially daring, sneak in a grounded or aerial \@B+C@ to throw off your opponent.\n
\k

\\@MESSAGE@
Start with a standing \@B@, continue into \@C@,\n
then use \@236+A@> follow-up \@6+A@ to stay safe.\n
Or, use Passing Link to stay safe with an \@A@ normal.\n
\n
If your attacks hit, follow up with normals or other pick-ups to deal more damage.\n
\k

\\@MESSAGE@
Once you get close to your opponent, try to confuse them with a low \@Z6+B@,\n
or \@Z+6C@, \@Z236B@, and \@214C@ as overhead options.\n
\n
As \@214C@ and \@Z236B@ are heavy hits, you should be careful while using them without access to Chain Shift.\n
\n
From an Assault, you can try use jumping \@C@ for a slow but reliable overhead attack.\n
\k

\\@MESSAGE@
When your opponent gets aggressive, try reversing the situation\n
with your invulnerable attacks, \@623+B@ or \@623+C@.\n
\n
If you use Chain Shift to confirm the situation first,\n
you won't miss a chance to deal damage.\n
\k

\\@MESSAGE@
If your opponent attacks from the air, you can attempt a starter using \@B+C@ or \@3+B@.\n
\@B+C@ can lead into a combo in the corner. Also, note that this attack can be Increased TWICE.\n
\n
\@623A@ is also a suitable anti-air that can start combos, but the follow-up timing is tricky.\n
\n
Lastly, Riesbyfe's Air Throw has a special counter-hit property, and will act as a combo starter.\n
The speed of this move cannot be underestimated, and can be a great option when assessing the situation with a Chain Shift.\n
\k

\\@MESSAGE@
If your opponent is threatening you with their projectiles, a properly-timed \@B+C@\n
will grant you a window of invulnerability to evade such attacks and give an opportunity to strike back.\n
\n
Try to hit the projectile with the Force Function, then attempt to follow-up with a powerful attack.\n
\k

\\@MESSAGE@
If you're stuck in an unfortunate position in the air, you might be able to evade a grounded opponent.\n
Try using an aerial \@B+C@ to dodge oncoming attacks before landing.\n
\n
While this dodge makes you invulnerable, you're unable to act while in the air, and you may be at risk while landing.\n
Use your aerial Force Function with caution to make the opponent whiff, then punish them.\n
\k
